selection: Latest201 complete admission-journal records before inspecting the200 adjacent timestamp differences; all records retained, no outcome or gap filtering.
transformation: Exact decimal subtraction of consecutive logged Unix timestamps. Every adjacent pair is retained and keyed to its ending decision round. No filtering, smoothing, interpolation or imputation.
scope: Calendar-time gaps between recorded adaptive adapter decisions; includes work, qualification waits and recording gaps. Not full-round compute time, single-proposal latency, deployment throughput or learning evidence.
